retrievalProfile.description: A vertical layout featuring a macro eye at the top and a full-body silhouette at the bottom, bridged by circular and ultra-condensed typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A vertical composition divided into two primary zones: a warm-toned macro close-up of a human eye at the top, and a cool-toned full-body figure at the bottom. The design uses a grainy, slightly desaturated texture reminiscent of early 90s print media, with text acting as a structural bridge between the two photographic elements.
coreVisualRelationships: Macro eye looking downward toward the central text
Circular text path echoing the curve of the lower eyelid
Full-body figure centered between large-scale background lettering
Warm sepia/gold top half contrasting with cool blue/white bottom half
coreInvariants: Macro eye as the primary top-half anchor
Ultra-condensed sans-serif typography in the lower third

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Macro eye occupies the top 40% of the frame; full-body figure is centered in the bottom 40% at a much smaller relative scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The pupil of the macro eye serves as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye looks down to the circular text, which leads the viewer to the central figure and the large vertical typography at the base.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample off-white/cream space in the center provides a buffer between the two photographic subjects.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black for the eye lashes and figure silhouette
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Sky blue for the large background lettering
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast in the subjects (eye and figure) against a low-saturation, high-value background.
paletteRestrictions: Cool blue for the base text

letterConstructionRules: Extreme vertical stretching for primary display text
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters in the lower display text are elongated to nearly 4x their standard height
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between wide-tracked circular text and ultra-condensed vertical display text.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary heavy, condensed skeleton for the display text.
Clean geometric feel for the circular subtitle text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a vertical image with a macro human eye at the top in warm tones and a full-body silhouette of a person in a black outfit at the bottom. The background should be a grainy, off-white cream color. Leave the middle section mostly empty.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a circular path of uppercase sans-serif text below the eye. At the bottom, place large, ultra-condensed blue text behind the silhouette, stretching the letters vertically.

verificationChecks: Is the eye at the top and the figure at the bottom?
Is the display text at the bottom vertically elongated?
Is the subtitle text following a circular arc?
Is the overall texture grainy and vintage?

adjustableVariables: Tightness of the circular text arc
mustRedesign: Avoid modern high-definition digital clarity; must maintain 90s print grain.
Do not use standard-width fonts for the bottom display text; it must be ultra-condensed.
postGenerationChecks: Check that the figure is layered in front of the large blue text.
Ensure the circular text is centered horizontally.
Verify the macro eye has visible lash detail and warm iris tones.
Confirm the background is a textured cream, not pure white.
recipe.reuseFormula: Macro Subject (Top) + Circular Text (Center) + Silhouette over Condensed Type (Bottom) + Grainy Texture = 90s Cassette Aesthetic
